title: FII NOCONTRACT marking used to hide UFO programs in DOE/NNSA national labs
place_text: Sandia, Lawrence Livermore, Los Alamos, Y-12/Oak Ridge

tellings.quote: I believe this is a security mechanism used for Department of Energy and their semi-autonomous subordinate agency, the National Nuclear Security Administration to offiscate UFO programs within DOE and NSA National Labs

plain: A security marking on records, "FII NOCONTRACT", is said to be used to hide UFO programmes inside the Department of Energy's national laboratories, such as Sandia, Lawrence Livermore, Los Alamos and Oak Ridge. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb puts this forward on the show as his own belief. He says it is a tool used by the Department of Energy and the National Nuclear Security Administration, its semi-autonomous nuclear weapons agency, "to obfuscate UFO programs," and he ties it to the UAP Disclosure Act, a bill in Congress on UAP, the government's newer term for UFOs.
